items.title: Nonacus report says funding gaps stall NHS adoption of new diagnostics such as GALEAS Bladder
items.summary: Birmingham diagnostics firm Nonacus's Faster Answers report argues NHS access to evidence-backed tests depends on local commissioning. Its urine-based GALEAS Bladder test is used at eight NHS sites; Leicester's pathway relies on time-limited funding ending April 2027.

items.title: NHS England — Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme - MRI Reporting Service (C473436)
items.summary: A national service to provide specialist interpretation of prostate MRI scans as part of the Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme. Responses by 11/11/2026 12:00.

items.title: NHS England — Targeted Prostate Cancer Screening Programme – PSA Laboratory Processing Service (C473446)
items.summary: Targeted prostate cancer screening pathway with a focus on men at increased risk due to an inherited BRCA2 variant. Responses by 11/11/2026 12:00.

items.title: Implementation and evaluation of a nurse-led clinic for men referred with suspected prostate cancer
items.summary: Background: Cancer diagnostic delays remain a challenge. Advanced nurse-led clinics represent an innovative approach to improving pathway efficiency while delivering person-centred care.

items.title: From validation trials to clinical reality: implementing AI-supported prostate MRI pathways in the NHS
items.summary: Prostate cancer remains the most common cancer diagnosed in men in the UK. The adoption of pre-biopsy multiparametric MRI (mpMRI) has improved diagnostic stratification, although it has concurrently increased the burden on radiology services.

items.title: Children as young as 13 seen by NHS for bladder damage caused by ketamine
items.summary: Children as young as 13 for bladder problems associated with ketamine use according to doctors who set up an NHS clinic to manage the problem.

items.title: Urine test could speed up bladder cancer diagnosis in patients with haematuria
items.summary: A non-invasive urine test could speed up diagnosis of bladder cancer, an NHS study has found. Trials of the GALEAS urine bladder test across seven NHS sites found it discovered nine in ten patients with the disease.

items.title: Boston Scientific wins £12.8k urology laser replacement at Swansea Bay
items.summary: Swansea Bay University Health Board has directly awarded Boston Scientific a contract to replace the end-of-life urology laser at Morriston Hospital with a Lumenis MOSES Pulse 120H device, worth £12,822.15 excluding VAT.
